1722-2034-3583-6094.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6094.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

4311-5078-7296-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1409-1939-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Lunarch Veteran trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

2724-3080-4064-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Abuelo by paying {1}{W}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-2921-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2060-4222-5027-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Gnostro does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Gnostro.
You have cast at least one spell this turn.
2060-4222-5027-6996.description:
Activate Gnostro by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Gnostro.
Repeat.

2906-2921-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2906-2921-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5645-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-7296.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1718-4924-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Heartless Summoning.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Heartless Summoning.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
1718-4924-6072-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

232-813-1235-4285.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Scholar of the Ages tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3809-4772-5686-7087.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

527-1369-7086.easyPrerequisites: Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
527-1369-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Selvala.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Selvala's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Selvala's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

1491-6723-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {1}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Tui and La by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

129-3812-5268.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3812-5268.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

1315-2292-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-2292-3234-3293.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
1315-2292-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

997-3769-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
997-3769-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

56-5695-6798.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

1878-2634-5195-5860.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1878-2634-5195-5860.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1878-2634-5195-5860.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

293-2438-5220-5716.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

3388-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-2567-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
2034-2567-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more lands, this combo nets infinite colorless mana and creature tokens.

1418-2103-2788-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1418-2103-2788-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3603-4050-4605-4681.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Preston.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Preston trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2034-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2034-4616.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

351-2118-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger and Loxodon Warhammer attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
351-2118-3957.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

933-1171-4872.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a copy of Regrowth using Garth's ability.
Garth does not have summoning sickness.
933-1171-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Garth.
Repeat each turn.

1368-2196-4684.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1368-2196-4684.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to loot twice and untap three lands.
Mesmeric Orb triggers three times, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.
